title: Pork and pineapple lettuce tacos
summary: Pork and pineapple lettuce tacos is a mexican dinner built around lean pork mince 5% fat and pineapple, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice lean pork mince 5% fat and pineapple before the pan is hot. Pork and pineapple lettuce tacos is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry lean pork mince 5% fat until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add pineapple and little gem lettuce, return lean pork mince 5% fat, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Pork and pineapple lettuce tacos before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
